questions.q:
20. The ratio of income and expenditure of a person is 8 : 5. If her income increases by 25% and her expenditure increases by 28%, then what is the percentage increase in her savings?

SSC CHSL 09/06/2022 (Evening)
questions.s:
20.(b)

Let the original income and expenditure be 8y and 5y respectively.

According to the question,

               Income = Exps + Savings

Original      8y     = 5y     + 3y

New           10y    = 6.4y + 3.6y

So, required percentage = 3.6y-3y3y×100 =0.6y3y× 100 = 20%

questions.q: Which of the following expressions is a factor of $(10^{12} - 1)$ but NOT a factor of $(10^6 - 1)$?
questions.s:
Answer is 101.
Dekh bhai, basic algebra zindabad! $(a^2 - b^2)$ ka formula laga. $(10^{12} - 1) = (10^6 - 1)(10^6 + 1)$. Question mein condition hai ki $(10^6 - 1)$ ka factor nahi hona chahiye. Matlab humein $(10^6 + 1)$ ka factor dhoondhna hai. $(10^6 + 1) = (10^2)^3 + 1$. Ise $(x^3+1)$ wale formula se kholega toh ek factor $(10^2 + 1) = 101$ aayega. Seedha nishana!

questions.q: Arrange the fractions  $\frac{5}{9}, \frac{4}{7}, \frac{3}{5}$ and,  $\frac{2}{3}$  in ascending order.
questions.s:
Given:

Fractions: 5/9, 4/7, 3/5, 2/3

Formula used:

Compare fractions using LCM of denominators

Calculations:

⇒ LCM of 9, 7, 5, 3 = 315

⇒ 5/9 = (5 × 35) / 315 = 175 / 315

⇒ 4/7 = (4 × 45) / 315 = 180 / 315

⇒ 3/5 = (3 × 63) / 315 = 189 / 315

⇒ 2/3 = (2 × 105) / 315 = 210 / 315

⇒ Ascending order:

⇒ 175/315 < 180/315 < 189/315 < 210/315

⇒ 5/9 < 4/7 < 3/5 < 2/3

∴ Ascending order is 5/9, 4/7, 3/5, 2/3.

·Anchal is the daughter of Arun who is the husband of Aman.

·Aman has three children i.e. 2 male and 1 female.

·Priya is married to Deepak who has three children.

·Ashu is the husband of Ashita, who has three children.

·Ashu and Deepak are the brothers of Anchal.

·Vishal is the only son of Priya.

So, Vishal is the grandson of Aman.

आठ सदस्यों वाले एक परिवार में गौतम, राम का दामाद है और राम, अमीषा से विवाहित है। अमीषा दो पुत्रियों की माता है। हातिम, यामी का ब्रदर-इन-लॉ है। दिशा, मनु और नैनो की माता है। हातिम एक पिता है। यदि परिवार में पाँच महिला सदस्य हैं, तो यामी किससे विवाहित है?
o_hi: None of theseइनमें से कोई नहीं
questions_hin.s_hi:
Gautam is the son-in-law of Ram, who is married to Amisha. Amisha is the mother of two daughters. Hatim is the brother-in-law of Yami. Disha is the mother of Manu and Nano. Hatim is a father.

questions_hin.q_hi: Which of the following expressions is a factor of $(10^{12} - 1)$ but NOT a factor of $(10^6 - 1)$?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Answer is 101.
Dekh bhai, basic algebra zindabad! $(a^2 - b^2)$ ka formula laga. $(10^{12} - 1) = (10^6 - 1)(10^6 + 1)$. Question mein condition hai ki $(10^6 - 1)$ ka factor nahi hona chahiye. Matlab humein $(10^6 + 1)$ ka factor dhoondhna hai. $(10^6 + 1) = (10^2)^3 + 1$. Ise $(x^3+1)$ wale formula se kholega toh ek factor $(10^2 + 1) = 101$ aayega. Seedha nishana!

questions_hin.q_hi: Arrange the fractions  $\frac{5}{9}, \frac{4}{7}, \frac{3}{5}$ and,  $\frac{2}{3}$  in ascending order.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Given:

Fractions: 5/9, 4/7, 3/5, 2/3

Formula used:

Compare fractions using LCM of denominators

Calculations:

⇒ LCM of 9, 7, 5, 3 = 315

⇒ 5/9 = (5 × 35) / 315 = 175 / 315

⇒ 4/7 = (4 × 45) / 315 = 180 / 315

⇒ 3/5 = (3 × 63) / 315 = 189 / 315

⇒ 2/3 = (2 × 105) / 315 = 210 / 315

⇒ Ascending order:

⇒ 175/315 < 180/315 < 189/315 < 210/315

⇒ 5/9 < 4/7 < 3/5 < 2/3

∴ Ascending order is 5/9, 4/7, 3/5, 2/3.
